question: Will Trump create Bitcoin reserve in first 100 days?
requirements: This market will resolve to "Yes" if the US government holds any amount of Bitcoin in its reserves at any point between January 20, 2025, ET and  April 29, 2025, 11:59 PM ET.
exclusions: Note that the US government confiscating Bitcoin does not count as holding Bitcoin reserves.
context: Otherwise, this market will resolve to "No".
The primary resolution source for this market will be official information from the US government and/or the US federal reserve, however a consensus of credible reporting will also be used.
